title: Existing WordPress menu edits include the native menu key
steps: Generate changesets for renamed, reordered, relinked and reparented existing menu items after a live-ID collision.
expect: Every update retains the base menu slug as key.
Live addresses use the mapped live ID while pushed seeds use the copy ID.
Only the edited field is written, with copy URLs mapped back to live.

tests: WordPress existing menu address is retained for title updates
WordPress existing menu address is retained for position updates
WordPress existing menu address is retained for url updates
WordPress existing menu address is retained for parent updates
